steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Tell us your platform, mode, rank and what you want to fix.

steps.title: Get a time
steps.text: If it's a fit, you'll get an email with times in your time zone.

steps.title: Play or send a VOD
steps.text: Join the call, or send a match for review.

steps.title: Keep the notes
steps.text: You get written notes and things to practise afterwards.

faq.a: The current competitive CoD and Warzone. If you play something older, mention it in the form.

faq.q: Do I need to be good already?
faq.a: No. Sessions start from where you are now.

faq.q: What do I need for a live session?
faq.a: The game, a mic and a stable connection. The call link comes by email once your time is booked.
